equivalence_boundaries: The single-helicity niche is an explicit Item 16 behavior control.
The two-helicity linear niche is an explicit Item 16 two-carrier behavior control.
A three-helicity candidate counts as non-equivalent only when all weights are positive and all three ranges are distinct.
An interaction candidate collapses to the linear niche when its interaction coefficient is zero; zero is not sampled.
Historical novelty is not inferred from algebraic non-equivalence and requires a separate literature audit.
